visualize_annotations_from_config: run the script with --source annotation to visualize ground-truth annotations from a Detectron2 config file
visualize_dataloader_with_preprocessing: run the script with --source dataloader to visualize data loader output including preprocessing steps
setup_detectron2_config: create a Detectron2 config object by merging a config file and command-line options then freezing it
parse_visualization_args: parse command-line arguments for source type, config file path, output directory, and display options
output_visualized_images: save or display visualized detection images with bounding boxes, masks, and keypoints to an output directory
